title: Interchange of Limit and Integration for Pulse Functions
expert_review: A high-level conceptual problem that addresses the mathematical rigor behind the Dirac Delta function and why standard calculus tools require extension to distribution theory.
source: Theory of Distributions and Linear Systems
learning_objectives: Identify why limits and integrals cannot always be interchanged
Compare pointwise limits with integral limits for singularity-prone functions
Explain the necessity of distribution theory in signal analysis
Analyze the boundedness of pulse functions during the limiting process
